reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline or comment, which is the expected output for a satisfied presence rule; the rendered redline is identical to the originals, so no risk of an invalid or directionally wrong edit.

Cited text supports the conclusion: p0200 (Freedom of Action) is mutual and expressly preserves each party's ability to contract with others, and no paragraph imposes a non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use covenant on Customer.

The Customer-side limits identified (no resale of the Services in p0190; use of Base Components solely in connection with the Services and no reverse engineering in p0149) are ordinary licence-scope/use restrictions, not restrictions on the businesses Customer may operate or products it may buy or build, so they correctly were not treated as deviations.

Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes, consistent with the preferred position; the rationale is accurate and appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
